description: Post a claim comment on a GitHub issue, shaped by the repo's contribution gates. Runs the verdict pipeline first and refuses on TAKEN/STALE verdicts or vouch-gated repos. DRY RUN BY DEFAULT: returns the comment plan without posting unless execute is true, and posting requires GITHUB_TOKEN.

eta_days.description: ETA in days recorded in the protocol claim comment (eta-days: line).

execute.description: Post the comment for real. Defaults to false: dry run returns the plan only.

force.description: Claim even on a TAKEN or STALE verdict.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

plan.description: Plan recorded in the protocol claim comment (plan: line).

name: claim_issue
